guard: the ACP agent keeps each protocol promise its docs make: a probe leaves no trace, a turn's updates and closed tool calls reach the client before the prompt answers, sign-in is offered and reported only where it applies, list and load show the right runs, later prompts are typed into the seat, end when it stops working and fail with the manager's reason when it refuses them, a cancel interrupts the seat and answers cancelled, also when the interrupt is refused or the session is deleted, a new session starts on a listed manager when none is on this machine, one silent manager hides only its own agents, and the frame mapping neither repeats nor misreports a seat's events; a person without spawn loads their agent with only its own model, and a seat no manager listed while one was silent is not called missing; a thread opened without spawn offers only its agent's model and cannot start another, and new threads start and agents are read where the auth service's manager list allows; a loaded agent keeps its manager as a choice and loads while no manager may start a new one, and a seat-only thread's options do not change; a new thread prefers a manager whose presence is current, an unlisted seat names the deregister command only where people sign in, a seat-only thread never points at /despawn, and a loaded thread's manager stays a described choice after a machine change
why: Each mutation is a plausible one-line regression in the protocol layer or the frame mapping. The smokes import src directly, so no build runs between the mutation and the suite.
